content.comment_body: Hello, I've started a small project using the [product_name] starter kit and [product_name] operator device. Is anyone available to chat online and answer my questions? I'm looking for advice on correct connections, such as how to set up all Ethernet cables, whether the wiring order matters, and how to properly connect to the [product_name] using [product_name] configuration software.

Hi [user_name], welcome to the forum. To get started, make sure your PC, [product_name] controller, and [product_name] operator device are all in the same network subnet. Connect your PC to the operator device with an Ethernet cable, and also connect the [product_name] controller to the operator device. The operator device acts like a network switch between devices.

Thank you! So, after connecting the PC with an Ethernet cable, in the [product_name] configuration software, should I choose the operator device or something else? I can't seem to find a device matching my [product_name] controller.
Can you provide the IP address and subnet mask for the PC? What are the IP address and subnet mask for the [product_name] controller? What about the operator device?
The IP addresses for both the PC and [product_name] controller are the same. Subnet mask is 255.255.255.0 for all.
If the PC and [product_name] controller have identical IP addresses, that won't work. You need to assign a unique address to the [product_name] controller within the subnet.

Does anyone know if you need to keep adding the new measurement value to the previous total? For example, if I have to measure flow every second, should I add each measurement so I can get the total flow over a certain period?
There's not enough information to help. Please provide data for your flow meter. Does your flow meter have digital or analog output?
The flow meter has a digital output.

analysis.insight_summary: A new user is seeking basic guidance on setting up a [product_name] Starter Kit with operator device, including proper hardware connections and configuration in [product_name] software. The user is unsure about Ethernet wiring, device identification in software, correct IP assignment, and connecting a digital-output flow meter for real-time data accumulation. Beginners may need clearer, step-by-step setup instructions and help with accumulating digital measurement values over time.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects easy-to-follow instructions for connecting hardware, configuring device settings, and performing straightforward accumulation of flow measurements using digital outputs in real time.
